add_library(assimp STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(assimp PROPERTIES
	INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES 	"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/includes"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION 				"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/assimp-vc143-mtd.lib"
	IMPORTED_LOCATION_DEBUG 		"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/assimp-vc143-mtd.lib"
	MAP_IMPORTED_CONFIG_DEBUG 		Debug)
